cases.purpose: Power-cut durability: with the seed on a journaled ext4 filesystem over a dm-flakey device, cutting the power (all further writes dropped, process killed) at the moment rngseed load is about to credit leaves no seed file after journal replay, while a plain unsynced unlink in the same model is lost and the file comes back
cases.oracle: A dm-flakey drop_writes model of a power cut on an ext4 loop device, replayed from the loop file; the control shows the model loses an unsynced removal, so the absence after rngseed load is due to the builtin's unlink plus directory fsync before the credit
cases.comparison: After the cut at the RNDADDENTROPY ioctl (seccomp user notification, ioctl never executed): names present on the replayed filesystem; control file names for an unsynced unlink.
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 0 && $EUID == 0 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t rngseed) == builtin ]] || exit 125
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/mig-w6-powercut.py "$BASH"
